tasks.title: Dependencies and the PHI-safe third-party call wrapper
tasks.test_approach: Unit tests with pytest capfd and caplog: call the wrapper on functions that raise with a fake path, warn, log through a named logger, print to Python stdout, and write to fd 2 via os.write.
criteria: pyproject.toml core dependencies include SimpleITK and DicomRTTool==6.2.0; uv.lock is updated; no mclahe, torch or torchio

A public wrapper (e.g. quiet_call(fn, reason)) runs fn with pydicom quieted (vault: pydicom-validates-lazily-on-first-tag-access), warnings recorded, Python logging records from any logger suppressed, sitk.ProcessObject.SetGlobalWarningDisplay(False), and fd 1/2 redirected at the os.dup2 level; all are restored afterwards

On failure it raises CaseRefused(reason) after the except block has exited, so the exception's message, __cause__ and __context__ contain no text from the original exception (vault: third-party-loader-errors-and-warnings-embed-phi-paths)
A test asserts that a fake path and a SYNTHETIC_ id raised, warned, logged, printed and written to fd 2 inside the wrapper appear nowhere in capfd output, caplog records or the exception chain
CaseRefused(reason) exists in the package and its str() is exactly the reason constant
dicom_io.read_header raises after its except block has exited; a test asserts the raised OSError has __context__ None and __cause__ None

The wrapper sets logging.disable(CRITICAL) and restores the prior level, and flushes sys.stdout/sys.stderr before each os.dup2 restore (DicomRTTool logs from ThreadPoolExecutor workers; tqdm writes to stderr)

tasks.title: convert: assemble, planning CT, dose, atomic plan folders, report
tasks.test_approach: Synthetic org trees in tmp_path (plan_<n> folders built with the writers, or via organize for A2.9); compare outputs with SimpleITK and numpy. Port rnt read_ct_series/_convert/resample_dose/write_atomic with their checks.
criteria: convert(org_root, out_root, *, exclude_models=('Acuity',)) returns ConvertReport(rows); it reads every <patient>/plan_<n>/ (patient folders starting with '.' and misc_files are never converted); a resolved out_root equal to or inside org_root raises ValueError(REASON constant) before any mkdir, and the CLI exits 1 with that reason

Assemble: exactly one RTPLAN, its RTSTRUCT by ReferencedStructureSetSequence[0], and exactly one CT series that RTSTRUCT references; otherwise CaseRefused with a fixed reason constant. An unreadable file in a plan folder refuses the plan. A plan-folder header missing a tag the per-plan path reads (e.g. ImagePositionPatient on a CT slice, ReferencedStructureSetSequence) refuses that plan with a fixed reason and the run continues; one fixture per such case

A2.1: planning_ct.nii.gz equals the source CT (spacing, origin, direction, values; series read with SetOutputPixelType(sitkFloat32) before Execute) and dose.nii.gz equals stored value x DoseGridScaling linearly resampled onto the CT grid

A2.1b: PLAN+BEAM -> the PLAN dose; PLAN+FRACTION -> the PLAN dose; one FRACTION -> used; two BEAM -> their sum on the CT grid; two PLAN -> refused; a single BRACHY -> refused; no RTDOSE -> converted with no dose.nii.gz; DoseUnits not GY -> refused; a used dose whose FrameOfReferenceUID differs from the CT -> refused

A2.1c: a planning CT missing a middle slice is refused (one-volume check: one orientation and size, no duplicate positions, uniform spacing within ORIGIN_ATOL_MM, at least two slices), and so is one missing an end slice that the RTSTRUCT's RTReferencedSeriesSequence item for the planning CT lists in ContourImageSequence
From A2.4b: with two CT series in the plan folder, the one the RTSTRUCT references is planning_ct.nii.gz
A2.8: a plan referencing a missing RTSTRUCT is refused; the convert_report.csv row carries the reason constant; no plan_<n>/, partial or temp folder is left

Each patient is built in <out_root>/.<patient>.partial/ (a stale one removed first) and renamed into place at the end; a refused plan leaves no plan_<n>/ while the patient's other plans are written (vault: record-completion-at-outcome-not-intent)
Every SimpleITK/pydicom read goes through the task-02 wrapper; no sitk.GetArrayViewFromImage on a temporary image (vault: simpleitk-array-view-of-temporary-image-reads-freed-memory)

Guardrail (commit gate): no added line puts mrn/patient_id next to a run of 6-10 digits (dates go through a variable defined on its own line) and no added line accesses an underscore-prefixed attribute of another module

DicomRTTool 6.2 runs once per plan inside the task-02 wrapper on a temp folder of hard links (copy fallback) to only the planning CT slices and the RTSTRUCT, placed inside the patient's partial folder and removed in every outcome: DicomReaderWriter(arg_max=False, verbose=False), walk_through_folders, set_contour_names_and_associations(contour_names=...), set_index(index of the planning CT SeriesInstanceUID), get_images_and_mask() (vault: dicomrttool-6-api-and-mclahe-deps)
